## Où j'en suis
PR #418 is merged. Its follow-up, PR #423, is open with keyboard move/resize and a visible focus ring implemented and tested. `dashboards_v2` is enabled for Zest on staging; production remains untouched. (source: ses-db-4, kestrel-analytics/platform#418, kestrel-analytics/platform#423)

- [en-cours] PR #423 is awaiting review/merge. (source: ses-db-4)
- [prochaine-étape] Have Priya rehearse the demo on staging; production flag is to be enabled separately on the morning of the 24th. (source: d4-06)
- [essai-raté] Wrapping the grid with dnd-kit caused arrow-key moves and mouse-drag layout changes to fire twice because both libraries handled the same events. (source: d4-02)
- [décision] Use a custom keyboard handler on top of the layout state, without dnd-kit. (source: d4-04)
